steps: Apply via the PEO Application Form on the Lorain County Board of Elections site
Attend a mandatory BOE training session and pass the assessment
Serve as a Precinct Election Official on Election Day
catches: Must be a Lorain County registered voter; no felony convictions
Must attend mandatory training and pass an assessment before serving
biggest_catch: You must attend mandatory training and pass an assessment before you can serve; pay is only earned for Election Day work
eligibility: U.S. citizen, registered voter in Lorain County, no felony conviction
timing: Election Day shift: arrive 5:30 a.m., polls open 6:30 a.m., work until 8:30 p.m.
